signals.note: 价格页当日快照（未标生效日）；V4-Pro 缓存价 $0.022/$0.044

signals.quote: GLM-5.3 $1.4 in / $0.26 cached / $4.4 out; GLM-5.3-Flash $0.15 / $0.03 / $0.50; GLM-4.7-Flash Free (per 1M tokens); cached-input storage 'Limited-time Free'.
signals.note: 价格页当日快照；GLM-5.3-Flash 发布日 2026-08-26（官方 release notes）

signals.quote: Gemini 4 Argon: input $2.00 through Nov 30, 2026, $4.00 from Dec 1; output $10.00 → $20.00; context caching $0.10 → $0.20 (implicit caching only). Free tier: not available.
signals.note: 文档页标注的发布/更新时间为 2026-10-22；12/1 起价格翻倍，需提前锁量

signals.quote: …reducing usage costs by 70%. Flat pricing per 1M tokens: $0.15 input · $0.60 output · $0.015 cached input.
signals.note: 官方 blog，文内明确 70% 降本与三档单价

signals.quote: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is here! Stronger benchmark performance, faster task completion, and shorter outputs than the previous version—a Pareto improvement in performance and cost.
signals.note: 官方账号原话，已打开原帖核对正文

signals.quote: Search & Fetch APIs are now open to everyone! Each endpoint: $0.75 per 1,000 calls… free for DeepSeek API users. Billing starts Oct 31, 2026, at 16:00 UTC.
signals.note: Harness/Claude Code/Codex 内的服务端调用目前免费，10/31 起计费

signals.quote: Muse Wonder from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available in Cursor! … Priced at $4/M input and $20/M output tokens.
signals.note: Meta 新模型在 Cursor 的定价，官方账号原话

signals.quote: …available today in the API at the same price as its predecessor… costs less than other frontier models.
signals.note: 涨价未发生：新款按前代原价卖，官方称比同类前沿语音模型便宜

signals.quote: Gemini 4 Argon is now available in Cursor! … Priced at $2/M input and $10/M output tokens.
signals.note: 编辑器侧转售定价，可与 Google 官方价对比

signals.quote: We're extending FREE Qwen 3.8 Max + Flash for 7 more days! And we've increased rate limits across all 3 models.
signals.note: 官方账号原话；免费期延长+提额，未写结束绝对日期

signals.quote: Haiku 5.5 … costs around 75% less to run [than Haiku 4.5]. Input $0.10/$0.50, output $0.50/$2.50, cache reads $0.01/$0.05 per 1M; new monthly API credit for Claude Max and Team subscribers.
signals.note: ≤100k / >100k 两档价；同时下调 Sonnet 5.5 缓存读价

signals.quote: Qwen 3.8 Max, Qwen 3.8 Flash, and Wan 3.0 are FREE on GMI Cloud for the next 12 hours … Running Qwen at scale? Apply for up to $10K in credits per org
signals.note: 渠道侧限时免费（GMI Cloud），另含最高 $10K 额度申请

signals.quote: …nearly matches GPT-6 Astra's intelligence … at one-fifth of Astra's standard input and output token prices. Cached input costs just $0.10 per million tokens—95% less than standard input pricing
signals.note: 同时给出缓存价 $0.10/M（比 GPT-6 Sol 缓存价再低 50%）

signals.quote: …priced the same as Sonnet 5 at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens … Cache reads cost $0.10 per million tokens, half of Sonnet 5's $0.20.
signals.note: 单价持平但缓存读减半，官方称每任务成本降约 30%

signals.quote: GPT-6 Sol: $4 → $2 input, $20 → $10 output (50% cheaper); GPT-6 Luna: $0.20 → $0.10, $1.20 → $0.50. Prices per 1M tokens.
signals.note: 官方定价表原文，降价幅度 50%

signals.quote: OpenAI caches that shared context … giving developers discounts of up to 90% on cached input tokens. We now give cache discounts for eligible shared prefixes reused within a 30-minute window.
signals.note: 缓存折扣最高 90%，新增 30 分钟窗口与命中诊断

signals.quote: Input and output tokens are $4 and $20 per million, 20% less than Opus 5. Cache reads … $0.20 per million tokens, 60% less than Opus 5 … 40% less than Opus 5 on typical workloads.
signals.note: Newsroom 公告页；另称提高 Pro/Max/Team 的五小时用量上限

signals.quote: …a provider gets to choose when during a 24 hour window they will complete the request, and in exchange they generally charge 50% (and sometimes less) of their normal per-token price.
signals.note: 覆盖 70+ 模型；Beta 期 23 万批次中位 7 分钟完成

signals.quote: More efficient architecture. Lower API prices… Off-peak rates are 50% of peak rates… New pricing takes effect at 04:00 UTC on Sept 10, 2026.
signals.note: 同文称 KV cache 仅需前代 1/4 HBM、1/8 SSD，直接压低 cache-hit 成本

signals.quote: The production version Qwen3.8-Flash will be available soon via QwenCloud API at just $0.16/1M input tokens and $0.47/1M output tokens.
signals.note: 官方账号公布 API 定价（发布时点）

signals.quote: For Free users, we're updating the default model to GPT-5.6 Luna and expanding access with unlimited text chats.
signals.note: 日期取自 OpenAI 官方 RSS pubDate；正文经代理抓取
